'''GEMINI 16''' was a [[GEMINI]] model [[Droid/Legends|droid]], one of thousands used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] as captains of the [[Eternal Fleet]].

==Biography==
[[File:GEMINI_16_approaches_Vinn_Atrius.jpg|thumb|250px|left|GEMINI 16 approaches Vinn Atrius.]]
After the [[Battle of Odessen]]<ref name="KOTFE 16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref> in [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date-4.7">{{TOR_updates|4.7}}</ref> the GEMINI droids were granted free will by [[SCORPIO]],<ref name="KOTFE 16" /> though this was later undone when Empress [[Vaylin]] ordered an Iokath combat droid she captured to restore them to their default settings.<ref name="KOTET 5">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=5}}</ref> GEMINI 16 avoided the fate of her sisters by severing her connection to the GEMINI network and became determined to keep her newfound freedom at any cost. After the [[Eternal Throne]] and the Eternal Fleet were taken over by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]], GEMINI 16 could still hear her sisters, indicating that she remained vulnerable to outside control. Seeking the destruction of the Eternal Fleet and the GEMINI network to fully liberate herself, GEMINI 16 contacted [[Vinn Atrius]], who had formed the [[Order of Zildrog]] with the goal of taking down the Alliance and its Commander. To that end, Atrius sought to use [[Zildrog]], an ancient [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] from [[Iokath]], though he did not know its whereabouts.

[[File:GEMINI_16_suspicious.jpg|thumb|left|250px|GEMINI 16 was suspicious of Theron Shan.]]
GEMINI 16 offered Atrius her knowledge of Zildrog's workings and location,<ref name="Nathema" /> which led to [[Theron Shan]] stealing the map to Zildrog's coordinates from the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]].<ref name="Copero">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref> GEMINI 16 warned Atrius that Shan should not be trusted, and had also gained access to the security footage inside the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]], allowing the Order of Zildrog to watch the Alliance's every movement for months.<ref name="Nathema" /> Learning the coordinates of Zildrog's location on [[Nathema]], the Order left their base of operations at the [[Abandoned listening post|Abandoned Listening Post]] and departed to Nathema, with several individuals who wanted to settle their personal vendettas with the Commander joining them. However, Theron Shan was acting as a double agent for the Eternal Alliance the whole time, and warned them of the Order's intentions, leading to [[Lana Beniko]] and the Alliance Commander [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|following them]] closely behind.

[[File:GEMINI_16_on_Nathema.jpg|thumb|right|220px|GEMINI 16 prepares to activate Zildrog.]]
Theron gave the Order the slip and rejoined his true allies, after which Atrius ordered GEMINI 16 to begin awakening Zildrog in [[Emperor's Vaults|his vault]] ahead of schedule. The GEMINI deceived and betrayed many of her allies, locking them inside energy transfer chambers to be used as fuel for Zildrog's awakening. Shan, Beniko and the Commander arrived to stop them, but GEMINI 16 had already awakened Zildrog and ordered it to use the ''[[Gravestone]]'' to attack the Eternal Fleet in orbit of Odessen. The destruction of the [[Eternal Fleet warship]]s, the Eternal Throne and the ''Gravestone'' robbed the Alliance of its most powerful assets, but also required Zildrog to recharge his power before another attack, leaving him vulnerable. GEMINI 16 engaged the intruders herself, but was defeated and destroyed, after which Beniko and the Commander destroyed Zildrog, putting an end to the Order's plans.<ref name="Nathema" />
